connector.name: Deputy Workforce MCP
connector.registryDescription: Read-only Deputy coverage, workload, timesheet, availability, and staffing signals.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package deputy-workforce-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hyperdrift-io account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
